routed_2026_10_18: [RESEARCH-AUTHOR-GRADE-1017 2026-10-18] Root cause confirmed from code: log_signal writes logged_at_utc only; dashboard.get_signals reads ts/timestamp and a fresh uuid id. New row owns the fix.
what: [dashboard][signals] GET /api/bot/signals serves timestamp "" on EVERY row and a fresh random uuid as id on every call (measured 2026-10-11: 2 rows, both timestamp "", strategies xrp_pullback_2h + mhg_pullback_1d). get_signals reads e.get('ts', e.get('timestamp','')) over the last 50 signal_audit.jsonl lines, so the writer's time key is neither; and only 2 of those 50 lines are buy/sell signals, so the Overview chart's signal overlay is near-empty and cannot be placed in time. Found by UI-UPGRADE-1 while timing the route. Fix: read 50 raw lines via the diag relay (audit?limit=100), name the writer's real time/id keys (src/runtime/pipeline.py log_signal), map them in dashboard.get_signals, and scan back until N signals rather than N lines.
